column1: # Dialogue lines. Columns (tab-separated):  npc <TAB> key <TAB> text
# Rows with the same npc + key are pages: one box each, click or press E for the next one.
# Text wraps by itself. Write \n to force a line break. Lines starting with # are ignored.
#   name             name on the dialogue box
#   greet            the first time you talk to them
#   hello            the line above the options every other time (one row picked at random)
#   ask:<question>   a question the player can click; its rows are the answer
#   before:<question> like ask:, but only offered until their side quest is done
#   after:<question> like ask:, but only offered once their side quest is done (what they tell you in return)
#   quest_offer      after clicking "Need a hand?": explains the side quest, then Accept / Not now
#   quest_waiting    asking about the quest without the items yet
#   quest_done       handing the items over (the reward is given after these)
# The dragon: quest0, quest1, ... are its hints for main quest 0, 1, ...; "Tell me more" goes to the next row.

column3: Cole the Lumberjack
Well I'll be... a dwarf, out of the caves! Haven't seen one of your kind in years.
Name's Cole. I keep these woods trimmed and the logs stacked.
Back again, little dwarf?
Fine day for chopping, eh?
Nothing beats swinging the axe to clear your mind.
The woods outside your cave. Pines all the way up to the cliffs.
Past the cliffs it's all snow and ice. Too cold for an old woodsman like me.
Not with your bare hands you can't! You'd want an axe.
I might have a spare one lying around... if you could do me a favor.
The big one in the cave? Heard it coughing all week. Each cough shakes the whole mountain.
If anyone can brew it back to health, I'd bet on a dwarf like you.
I heard legends of a mystical herb up in the peaks. Don't know if that will be useful to you though.
Matter of fact, I could. My old legs aren't what they used to be.
Bring me a Haste Potion and I'll be quick as a fox again. They say the fae grass in these woods does the trick.
Do that, and my spare axe is yours.
Ha! Good dwarf. Faegrass powder brewed into a base potion, if I remember right.
No rush. The trees aren't going anywhere.
No potion yet? Crush some fae grass and brew it with a base potion. That should do it.
Oh, that's the stuff! I feel ten years younger already.
Here's the axe, as promised. Give a tree a few good swings and down she comes.
And bring me your lumber whenever you like. I'll saw it into planks for you, two for one.
Nivra the Ice Elf
A dwarf? This high up? You must be lost... or very brave.
I am Nivra. I keep watch over these frozen peaks.
The wind sings today.
Mind the ice, little one.
Still not frozen? Good.
The last of the frost elves who keep these peaks. We remember what the lowlands have long forgotten.

column2: ask:Why is the dragon so sick?
column3: Potions can soothe it for a while. Only something with life itself in it could rekindle a flame like that.

column2: before:Have you heard of the Life Dew?
column3: Up here, knowledge is paid for in warmth. Ask if I need a hand.
My fingers have been numb for a hundred winters.
Brew me a Warmth Potion from the flameflowers that grow between the rocks, and I will tell you everything I know about the Life Dew.
Crush the flameflowers and brew the powder with water. Distill that into crystals, heat the crystals in a furnace, then brew four of them with a base potion.
The cold is patient. So am I.
No warmth yet? Flameflower powder and water, then the distiller, then the furnace, then four crystals and a base potion in the brewer.
Ahh... warmth. I had forgotten what it felt like.
A promise is a promise. Ask me anything about the Life Dew.
It is life itself, gathered into a single drop of light.
Brewed into the right elixir, it could rekindle even a dragon's dying fire.
Higher in these peaks, past the frozen lake, there is a hollow where the snow never stops falling.
In its heart grows a single plant with a bulb full of light. Press it gently and it gives up its dew.
Only one drop ever grows. Waste it, and it is gone for good.

column3: That storm is no ordinary snow. Its cold would freeze you solid long before you reached the center.

column2: after:How do I get through the snowstorm?
column3: You need a potion that holds both fire: flameflower to keep your blood warm.

column2: after:How do I get through the snowstorm?
column3: Brew them together with the crystals from flameflowers.
Steph the Miner
hmmm... haven't seen you around here.
I'm Steph. I mine for a living, but shiny stone is what I truly yearn for.
hmmm... Anything to your interest?
The lakeside forest. Path to the mine is blocked, so I'm resting here.
Meanwhile, I've spent my time appreciating those peculiar birds.
Nothing as long as I'm stuck below.
O Certainly. It was its coughing that blocked the mine's entrance, after all.
If I could fly up over this hill, I could have clear the debris from behind.
hmmm... aye. There is something I could use your help for.
See those birds flapping around? Turns out their feather are great for brewing.
If you get your hands on their feather danders, and brew it,\nthere's a potion that let ya float.
I will give you something useful, if you could give me one of those potion.
Great! (placeholder dialogue)
No rush.
The bird runs fast, so you might wanna run faster to catch up.
Oh, that's the stuff! Beautiful potion!
Here's a secret. If you distill any potion, you get crystals. Some crystals have special effects.
Try use the haste crystal on a plant. See what happens...
Wooden Bridge
A broken wooden bridge... Can it be repaired?
A bridge...?
The bridge requires some planks to be repaired.
Let's repair the bridge! Perhaps the Lumberjack could help.
Perhaps not now...
The bridge still needs more planks. The lumberjack could help.
The bridge is fully repaired!

Handbook
A handbook with the title "How to smith items - from beginner to expert".
The smithing recipes handbook.
2 copper = 2 pipes\n3 quartz = 6 bottles\n3 rocks = chest
2 pipes = splitter\nSmithing converts splitter, joiner and crossover.
3 copper + 1 iron = brewer\n3 copper + 1 rock = crusher\n3 copper + 1 lumber = furnace
2 rock + 2 quartz = siphon\n2 iron + 2 quartz = distiller\n2 planks + 2 quartz = fermenter
5 copper + 5 planks = golem
Machines can be placed on the ground.\nPress "R" to rotate the them, or for pipes, change color.
Brewer is the core of everything. Brew any powder-like items into liquids for potions.
Stone press crushes items into dust. Furnace bakes and burns ingredients.
Distiller distills the soluted crystallites from potions.
Fermenter can ferment items, and produce infused water. It is sometimes an alternative to brewing.
Siphon fills bottles with water. Altar removes water from anything and return emptied bottles.
Dragon
Cough cough... I'm sick...\nplease bring me medicine my dwarf...\nI require the elixir of life...
The cave collapsed and stones block you way... \ncough, because, ...\nmy coughs... *ACHOOOO*.
Your pickaxe is missing... \nwhere is it...?
If a rock is too heavy...\nDrink some Drupe Drink to bulk up...
You've brewed Drupe Drink... \ndrink it and find your pickaxe...\nAnd bring back the furnace...
You can press `interact`\nto push a rock...\nafter a bottle of Drupe Drink.
Collect some copper ore by mining...\nAnd give it to me, to smith pipes.
Furnace is very powerful...\nDry the lichens... and grind them.
Lichen powder yields a red solution...\nAdd drupe to it...\nto brew stronger potions...
I can smith new machines for you...\nBring materials.
You've mastered brewing...Please bring me 8 Strength potion... to heal my claws...
Machines are powerful. Link more machines together to automate...
You can craft Golems. They patrol near their fuelbox,\ncollect items from closest place, and put in closest chest.
My claws are healed... *ACHOOOO*. But my muscles are still tired... Bring me 7 haste potions.
Haste potions can be crafted from faegrass.\nThey grow outside the cave. Grind them and brew.
Great... Next, I need to heal my wings... Bring me 8 float potions.
Float potions are not the easiest to craft...\nYou will need Vulmanid feathers.
There are several ways to process Vulmanid feathers...\nYou can grind them, but inefficient. Try fermenting...
Great... Next, *ACHOOOOOOO!!!*, ..., I need warmth in my lungs. Bring me 8 warmth potions...
Brew potions from flameflowers... But they are unpure in its raw form. Dissolve it, then distill it...
Thank you for all your hardworking... But to fully heal, bring me the final elixir of life...
Elixir of Life must be brewed from the Dew of Life,\ncombined with the Essences of the four elements...
You may ask around to learn where the Dew of Life might be...
